newsitem.title: USA: Hadron Inc sells unit to management.
newsitem.headline: Hadron Inc sells unit to management.

text.p: Hadron Inc said on Friday it has completed the sale of its HeaTreaT software products, effective as of June 30, 1997, to a company formed by former managers.
Hadron said it received a 10 percent equity stake in Performance Engineering International Corp, which is the name of the company run by former Hadron managers that developed the software.

Hadron also received two promissory notes totaling approximately $2,000,000 from Performance Engineering, secured by the HeaTreaT software and certain other transferred assets, Hadron said in a statement.

Gain on the sale will be recognized for financial reporting purposes on the installment method, only as principal payments are received, the company said. Such payments are expected to commence in fiscal year 1999.
Hadron will invest $20,000 a month in PEI for the next six months, and will assist with certain HeaTreaT marketing programs, the company said.
